keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Pablo Ortíz (Club Tijuana).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Necaxa 1, Club Tijuana 0. Danny Leyva (Necaxa) right footed shot from outside the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Lorenzo Faravelli with a cross following a corner.
Rafael Fernández (Club Tijuana) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Adonis Preciado (Club Tijuana).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Necaxa 1, Club Tijuana 0.
Substitution, Necaxa. Juan Valencia replaces Julián Carranza.
Substitution, Club Tijuana. Elias Manoel replaces Mourad El Ghezouani.
Substitution, Club Tijuana. Unai Bilbao replaces Pablo Ortíz.
Raúl Martínez (Necaxa) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Adonis Preciado (Club Tijuana).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Necaxa. Joshua Palacios replaces Lorenzo Faravelli.
Substitution, Club Tijuana. Yael Padilla replaces Gilberto Mora.
Substitution, Necaxa. Leroy Davis replaces Raúl Martínez.

keyEvents.text: Substitution, Necaxa. Alexis Peña replaces Owen González.
Substitution, Club Tijuana. Diego Abreu replaces Francisco González.

Delay in match (Club Tijuana).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.

Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Iván Tona (Club Tijuana) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Necaxa 1, Club Tijuana 0.
